8008.title: Codex provider emits network and shell-environment overrides
8008.rootCauseOneLine: The workspace policy unconditionally enables network access, and the same provider environment is sent to both the app-server process and shell_environment_policy.set overrides.
8008.proposedFix: Validate real Codex effective-policy enforcement and separate process-only authentication from command-visible environment contributions; changes require security-boundary review, so no automatic PR was safe.
8008.caveats: Repeated bridge-boundary reproduction in two clean trusted checkouts. No live Codex requirements enforcement, shell filtering, network access, real credential exposure, or service-wrapper deployment was tested.
